programme.title: The Borderless World
programme.desc: Led by experienced journalists, this current-affairs documentary travels beyond borders to investigate major international stories and social issues. Each report combines on-location observation, interviews and human perspectives to explain how global events affect ordinary lives.

programme.title: Mr.Player
programme.desc: Jacky Wu leads a team of celebrity guests through energetic missions staged in different destinations. The players compete in creative games, physical challenges and surprise tasks that test teamwork, strategy and humour.

programme.title: Flavor of Life
programme.desc: After leaving a successful but unfulfilling career, Han-Shiao reopens her familys beloved bistro to rebuild her life and reconnect with her loved ones. As old romances return, hidden family secrets emerge, and three generations of women face love, sacrifice, forgiveness, and new beginnings.

programme.title: Someone Like Me
programme.desc: Mui, who lives with cerebral palsy, longs for connection and meets volunteer Kin. As their wounded souls grow closer, she begins to rethink love and her self-worth beyond the limits of her body, discovering the courage to embrace life and intimacy on her own terms.

programme.title: My Date With A Vampire ((我和僵尸有个约会))
programme.desc: Demon slayer Ma Siu Ling crosses paths with the mysterious detective Fong Tin Yau while investigating a series of bizarre cases. As distrust gives way to an unlikely alliance, the two uncover long-buried secrets and face powerful supernatural forces in a battle against the dark conspiracy threatening the city.

programme.title: Trouble Girl (困难女孩)
programme.desc: Xiao Xiao suffers from ADHD and faces bullying in school. Her mother sees her as a troublemaker, while her father toils abroad. The only solace comes from her empathetic teacher, Paul. During a typhoon, Xiao Xiao discovers a secret between her mother and Paul, unravelling complex emotions and shared helplessness in life. (小在学校遭受欺凌.她的母亲认为她是一个麻烦者,而她的父亲在国外劳动.唯一的安慰来自她的同情教师保罗.在台风期间,小发现了她母亲和保罗之间的秘密,解开了复杂的情绪和生活中的共同无助.)

programme.title: The Movie Emperor ((红毯先生))
programme.desc: Hong Kong megastar Lau Wai Chi aspires to win a film award. He teams up with director Lin Hao to make a film about rural China so as to win at the international film festival, and experiences local village life for the farmers role. This ends up in a series of hilarious events instead. (香港巨星Lau Wai Chi希望赢得电影奖。 他与导演Lin Hao合作制作一部关于中国农村的电影,以便在国际电影节上获胜,并体验当地乡村的生活,让农民扮演角色。 结果,这在一系列有趣的活动中出现。)

programme.title: Cold War 2 ((寒战2))
programme.desc: Sean Lau is now the Police Commissioner after the successful rescue operation Cold War. However, the culprits from the past not only dodged justice but even escalated their actions and kidnapped Laus wife. He breaks every protocol to get her back, which puts him under investigation. (刘肖恩在冷战救援行动成功后现在担任警务专员。 然而,过去的罪犯不仅逃避了司法制裁,甚至升级了他们的行动,绑架了刘易斯的妻子。 他打破了所有协议,将她送回去,这让他受到调查。)

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles ((无敌幸运星))
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Burning Stars ((孤星计划))
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai under the shadow of White Terror, agent Li Yi Min is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. He reunites with former allies to break through deadly traps. Amid the turmoil, a group of idealistic youths join the cause, risking everything to uphold the mission and find courage in a time of chaos.

programme.title: Just 1 Day (只有一个天)
programme.desc: Mosaic, an urban sketcher, is suffering from ALS and wants to create some fond memories as his condition worsens. When Mosaic reunites with his old classmate Angelfish, whom he has a crush on since primary school, he asks her to fulfill his one last wish by becoming his girlfriend for just one day. Will Angelfish say yes?

programme.title: Love After Love ((爱在狱外))
programme.desc: Directed by Ann Hui, the movie is adapted from Eileen Changs first short story. Set in 1930s, Wei Long travels to Hong Kong from Shanghai to pursue her education. Struggling financially, she asks her aunt to help pay for tuition but ends up being her aunts puppet to lure rich men. When Wei Long falls for playboy, George, she sinks into a life of depravity.

programme.title: Caught In Time ((除暴·独家纪录片))
programme.desc: Based on true events, Detective Zhong Cheng leads a task force in pursuit of Eagle, a criminal gang led by Zhang Sun. Highly methodical and disciplined, the gang manages to avoid capture after each heist. A decade later, the need to stop Eagle is more urgent than ever when Zhong Cheng realizes that his time is almost up to solve the case.

programme.title: Shes Got No Name ((酱园弄·翻案))
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks Jiang Yuan Nong. Frail woman Zhan Zhou Shi, driven to despair by years of domestic abuse, kills and dismembers her husband, then remains at the scene to surrender. The case seems clear-cut, yet remains riddled with doubt. As the truth unravels, a shocking reversal rewrites everyones fate.

programme.title: Lonely Eighteen ((我们的十八岁))
programme.desc: Set in the 1980s Hong Kong, Elaine and her best friend Ying enter the entertainment industry hoping to change their fates from poverty. Ying soon becomes a popular porn star but Elaine is lost between being her true self and an actress. When show business declines after a decade, their choices lead them to two different paths in life.

programme.title: Death Stranding ((死亡搁浅))
programme.desc: To overhaul the underground gambling industry, the police join hands with the gambling association to crack down on illegal casinos. They auction off new casino licenses to regulate the industry, but this results in an upheaval in the gambling world, unveiling the hidden interests and secrets while sparking conflicts between gangs...

programme.title: OMG! Moms Big News ((OMG! 阿妈有喜))
programme.desc: 53-year-old Rita and her husband are planning retirement when she discovers shes unexpectedly pregnant, upending their quiet family life. As they prepare for the baby amid chaos and laughter, they learn profound lessons in love and acceptance. Just as peace returns, Rita learns the fetus may have Down syndrome, confronting her with the ultimate crossroads (53岁的丽塔及其丈夫正计划退休,当她发现自己意外怀孕,结束平静的家庭生活,在混乱和欢笑中为婴儿做准备时,他们在爱和接受方面学到深奥的教训。 正如和平回来一样,丽塔学习胎儿可能患有唐氏综合症,面对她终极十字路口。)

programme.title: Golden Boy ((金童))
programme.desc: After a decade in prison, former boxer Cheung Lek meets his son for the first time. Forced to live together for an inheritance, the estranged pair struggles to rebuild trust. As Cheung Lek returns to the ring for one last shot at redemption, he must confront his past and fight for a future with his son. (在监狱服刑十年后,前拳击手张立首次见到儿子。 被迫共同生活是为了继承遗产,这是为重建信任而争斗的一对纷争。 当张乐返回拳击场争取救赎的最后一击时,他必须面对过去,与儿子为未来而斗争。)

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon ((8块钱富豪))
programme.desc: When a struggling painter receives a magical wallet that endlessly produces RM8 notes, his life transforms from hardship to luxury. However, is this miracle truly a blessing or a hidden curse? (当一个苦扎的画家收到一个无休止地产生RM8笔钱包时,他的生活从困难转变为奢品.)

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandoras box ((大话西游之月光宝盒))
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandoras Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: The Wandering Earth II ((流浪地球2))
programme.desc: In this prequel, humans build enormous engines on the Earths surface to find a new home when the sun is burning out. In the dangerous universe, a group of young people has to step forward once again to fight in the critical battle to save the Earth.

programme.title: Smashing Frank ((捣破法兰克))
programme.desc: Four young thieves wearing bunny masks pull off the heists targeting the rich. Calling themselves Frank, their mission is less about money and more about exposing corruption through graffiti and viral videos. However, when they collide with a powerful church involved in a money-laundering scheme, their mission spirals into a deadly game. (四个戴着兔子面具的年轻盗贼把抢劫者从富人身上拉出来。 弗兰克(Frank)自称“弗兰克 ”, 他们的任务不是金钱,而是通过涂鸦和视频视频揭露腐败。 然而,当他们与参与洗钱计划的强大教会串通时,他们的任务就变成了一场致命的游戏。)

programme.title: The Medallion ((飞龙再生))
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival. (香港侦探Eddie在拯救一个神话般的儿童时,在国际搜寻人口贩运集团的过程中死亡。 被神圣的Cadellion所恢复,他获得了非凡的治疗力量。 然而,当他的无情的神经元也夺取了它的权力时,Eddie必须冲进一个险恶的城堡,为生存进行残酷的斗争。)

programme.title: A Writers Odyssey II
programme.desc: Fallen novelist Lu Kong Wen is drawn into the fantasy world of his own novel, where a powerful villain awakens with self-awareness and plots to invade reality. Forced to join forces with his fictional heroes, Lu becomes caught in a cross-dimensional battle that will determine the fate of both worlds.

programme.title: Love Never Ends ((かぐや様は告らせたい-ファーストキッスは終わらない-))
programme.desc: An empty-nest elderly man and a widowed elderly woman who collects scrap, meet unexpectedly and gradually develop feelings for each other. An elderly couple whose wife suffers from a serious illness, makes a living by selling scrap. Both these elderly couples fall deeply in love and prove that love never ends, even if there is no tomorrow!

programme.title: Detrimental ((见怪))
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster. (你智廉是个盲人,他在一个外岛的工厂工作。当工厂有一天被飓风与外界隔绝时,一个怪物出现,把任何人看到它变成黑影。你看不到怪物,他能够帮助其他同事安全逃脱,并战斗杀死怪物。)

programme.title: Scare Out ((异类))
programme.desc: A leak of core technology from an advanced fighter jet programme sparks a national security crisis. As an intelligence units urban manhunt for the spy falters, suspicion turns inward, falling on one of their own. Trust unravels as two top agents, once allies, are drawn into a silent, ruthless duel where one misstep could prove fatal.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix ((凤还巢))
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friends son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding... (一位帝国大臣郑正春向朋友的儿子穆。 他的妻子拒绝让叶欣在她丑陋和不受欢迎的大女儿Yan面前结婚。 杨奉命假装是叶相见,但他却吓跑他。 一位喜欢叶爱的有钱人却假装是穆爱参加婚礼。)

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket ((奇门怪招烂头蟀))
programme.desc: Inspired by Drunken Master, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Merry Wife ((娃娃夫人))
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute! (一位17岁的女学生娶了她35岁的老师。喜剧在他们试图将关系秘密化时出现,尽管他们在同一所学校。 当他们发现那些不想要的求婚者追求另一半时,嫉妒有可能随时暴露他们的婚姻!)

programme.title: The Knight Of Knights ((文素臣))
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his armys help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: Big Times For The Crazy Bumpkins ((阿牛发达记))
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman ((儒侠))
programme.desc: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the Sun and Moon secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and two beautiful Uyghur princesses, leaving him caught between his duty and their devotion.

programme.title: The Venus Tear Diamond ((钻石艳盗))
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love? (传奇的竞争对手珠宝盗窃者香水之夜和夜间伯爵前往日本偷走着著名的金星眼钻石. 他们一目睹就很快就恋爱了,而不知道另一个人是他们的竞争对手,并追求同样的奖励.谁将获得钻石,这将意味着他们新发现的爱情结束吗?)

programme.title: The Duel of the Century ((陆小凤之决战前后))
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall ((王昭君))
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Huns warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself. (王赵军拒绝贿赂帝国画家,因此他画了一张她丑陋的肖像,阻止她被皇帝选中,直到他们见面。 画家最终流亡在外,并阴谋让王朝嫁给洪军阀,以报仇。 皇帝拒绝了这一提议,挑起一场战争,只有王王自祭才能避免战争。)

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears ((英雄无泪))
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment ((没有老公的日子))
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer 1M for her baby... (当一位医生的丈夫东先生在一次事故中受致命伤时,他向她透露了他与小黑的婚外情,他与小黑怀孕了。 尽管背叛的破坏和丈夫最终死亡,但她婆婆还是施加压力,要她忍受小黑,为她的孩子提供1M。)

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web ((盘丝洞))
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brothers Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang. (在沙夫兄弟的第三部"向西方之旅"中,唐山宗被七个诱惑性蜘蛛灵困在困境中,他们决心通过吃他来实现不朽!)

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing ((茅山僵尸拳))
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts! (陈先生和他学徒的范家运送僵尸来谋生,他们被雇用一去搬9个僵尸。当2个跳跃离开时,人们发现一个人实际上是一个伪装的人,试图逃离敌人。事实证明变形僵尸和陈先生都是武术专家!)

programme.title: Super Inframan ((中国超人))
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth ((大地儿女))
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows... (这是中日战争时期的史诗故事。 一位画家于优拯救了一位年轻女孩Lotus,Lotus,她正被卖给妓院。她们坠入爱河,结婚并安顿下来过上平静的生活。然而,他们的生活很快被日本的入侵和随后的残暴政权所摧毁。)

programme.title: Hex vs Witchcraft ((邪斗邪))
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment. (一个有不良运气的强迫博者欠钱一个暴力的帮派老板,他把他的妻子作为首付,让她离开他.)

programme.title: The Convict Killer ((插翅难飞))
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - Black Leopard. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of Black Leopard, except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: The Human Goddess ((仙女下凡))
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins. (第七修女,一位来自天堂的好奇仙女,降至1970年代的香港。 迷失在一个陌生的世界中,她被一个负债累累的孤儿院的东志拉普拯救。 当一个大亨用地夺取土地时,她利用自己的力量保护土地,而一个不可能发生的浪漫开始。)

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West ((西游记))
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zangs journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing. (故事是从同名的经典中国小说中改编的.故事讲述了唐山宗僧侣前往西方寻找佛教的苏格拉.在路上,他遇到了子,猪和沙武.)

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate ((舞衣))
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love. (这部杰作讲述了香港社会对爱情的不同观点和女性对爱情的不同观点的三个相互联系的故事.)

programme.title: The Swift Knight ((快杰狮子丸))
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperors nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue

programme.title: The Snake Prince ((蛇王子))
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs... (蛇王子住在康西的蛇山上,他们和人类生活和平,一千年.然而,一切都改变了,当蛇王子爱上了三位美女之一,在附近村庄表演一个感觉般的雨舞,)

programme.title: All Men are Brothers ((新水浒传))
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Chang Chehs epic The Water Margin, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country. (这是一部长的史诗"水边缘"的续集,讲述了108名流浪者在梁山的七名战士的爱国故事.)

programme.title: Young Lovers ((年轻的情人们))
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock n roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls. (范,一个吉他的富人,前往日本加入一支摇滚乐队,)

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel ((武林风云))
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wus son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiongs three daughters. Eventually, Gans daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their fathers death.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Yaanai
programme.desc: In Ramnad, PRV juggles life with his two wives and kids while facing blame from another family for his brothers death. Tensions rise as their stories intertwine.

programme.title: Kedikkellam Kedi
programme.desc: Sreenu wins Shruthis love after driving away rival Bhavani, but trouble follows when Rajanna kidnaps her and demands Sreenu marry his daughter, forcing him into a dangerous dilemma.

programme.title: India Pakistan
programme.desc: Two aspiring lawyers, not knowing that both are of the same profession, share the same office. Things take a turn when they work on the same case.

programme.title: Valimai
programme.desc: A citys crime rate rises due to a notorious motorcycle club. When chaos ensues, police officer Arjun takes charge to restore law and order.

programme.title: Bhaskar Oru Rascal
programme.desc: Two kids, each from a single-parent home, team up to bring their moms and dads together, hoping to create the happy, complete family theyve always wanted.

programme.title: Kolamaavu Kokila
programme.desc: A young girl in Tamil Nadu turns to the local drug gang to save her dying mother, risking danger, loyalty, and her own future dramatically today.

programme.title: Theeni
programme.desc: Dev, an overweight but genius chef, falls in love with his charming colleague, Tara. However, their love story takes a turn when Maya, a happy-go-lucky woman, enters their lives.

programme.title: Jaihind 2
programme.desc: Karate teacher Abhinandan becomes a media sensation after advocating for government takeover of private schools to ensure equal education opportunities, facing threats from school owners.

programme.title: Lakshmi
programme.desc: Lakshmi dreams of winning a national level dance competition but is scared to participate as her mother despises dancing. However, things take a turn when she meets Krishna, a cafe owner.

programme.title: Love Story
programme.desc: A Christian Zumba instructor falls in love with a starry-eyed upper caste Hindu girl. In their quest for happiness, however, they must first overcome a massive caste divide.

programme.title: Bangalore Naatkal
programme.desc: Three cousins, Arjun, Divya, and Kannan, move to Bangalore for different reasons. Their journey is filled with challenges that alter their lives irrevocably.
After mobiles start mysteriously flying out of the hands of people in Chennai, Dr Vaseegaran summons his trusted robot Chitti to ward off the bird-shaped supernatural powers of Pakshirajan.

programme.title: Magalir Mattum
programme.desc: Prabhavati, a filmmaker, with help from her friends takes her mother-in-law, Gomatha, on a surprise trip to reunite with her school friends.

programme.title: CBI 5
programme.desc: After a series of murders take place one after another, a police officer decides to investigate the case himself and bring the killer to justice.

programme.desc: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon ((Wild Side of 从地球到月球))
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon ((Wild Side of 从地球到月球))
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Mysteries Of Evolution ((Mysteries Of X战警：进化))
programme.desc: Some call them living fossils, but thats just another way to say survivors. From the shark to the horseshoe crab, these animals early adaptations were a success, leaving them relatively unchanged for millions of years.

programme.title: Animals At Play ((动物玩耍))
programme.desc: Explore the ways that animals use play, including young gibbons in Thailand that practice falling from branches, elderly macaques that preserve their brains with playtime, and games that sharpen the profound intelligence of African elephants. (探索动物玩耍的方式, 包括泰国年轻长袍, 练习从树枝上掉下来,)

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa ((了不起的非洲公园))
programme.desc: In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here - from the magnificent to the bizarre. This is the Garden Route National Park. (在一个陆地与海洋交汇的公园里,自然元素结合了各种自然元素,创造了各种奇妙的品种。可兰花颜色的海水为绿色和稠密的森林提供原料。火和风能以巨大的多样性和岩石的生长为燃料,形成了多面的海岸线。这里的生活蓬勃发展,从壮丽的到奇异的。这就是花园之路国家公园。)

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa ((了不起的非洲公园))
programme.desc: In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing - water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. Its a lifeline to all creatures, great and small. (在克鲁格国家公园的北端,生命取决于一件事——水。 在受炎热和干旱重压的土地上,单条丝带在荒野中切开其可靠路线。它是所有生物的生命线,不分大小。)

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa ((了不起的非洲公园))
programme.desc: Augrabies is where the mighty Orange River plunges over the awesome 56 meter Augrabies waterfall. Derived from a word oukurubes which means place of thunder in the indigenous language of the Nama-Khoi this land is the heart of a harsh and sun-beaten world with flashes of brilliant color and a thunderous roar. (强大的奥兰治河(Augrabies)在56米高的奥兰比河瀑布上喷洒了巨大的56米高的瀑布。 从一个词“oukurubes ” ( oukulubes ) 衍生出在纳马科伊土著语中的雷鸣之地,这片土地是一个严酷和阳光严酷的世界的中心,其闪耀的颜色闪耀和雷鸣。)

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa ((了不起的非洲公园))
programme.desc: Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africas greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey in search of what they need to survive, and each must decide where and when to move if theyre to succeed... These are the magical worlds of the Lower Zambezi.

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa ((了不起的非洲公园))
programme.desc: In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent - Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19th century, the parks establishment gave rhinos a lifeline - breeding them back from extinction.

programme.title: Turtle Beach ((龟滩沥血))
programme.desc: Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs. (当地人称之为" arribada",即到达.)

programme.title: Wild Latin America ((魅力南美洲))
programme.desc: Get to know South Americas only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru. (亲眼目睹眼熊的尬和魅力,玩,食,并在秘鲁北部的偏远的夏帕里生态保护区寻找伴侣.)

programme.title: Shark Squad ((鲨鱼小队))
programme.desc: Off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, top shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a television first. Get a unique view as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white, revealing how it swims, hunts, and ultimately strikes its prey.

programme.title: Shark Squad ((鲨鱼小队))
programme.desc: Travel to a remote part of the Bahamas to unlock shark secrets. Do they make friends? Where do they give birth? Are some bolder than others? The answers may help protect these supreme predators for generations to come.

programme.title: Shark Squad ((鲨鱼小队))
programme.desc: In some of the most-remote regions on the planet, researchers dive deep and brave danger to unlock secret shark behaviours, challenge myths about sharks, and fight for the protection of these supreme predators - before its too late.

programme.title: Shark Squad ((鲨鱼小队))
programme.desc: Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. Find out how these graceful top predators interact, choose friends, and even teach other sharks.

programme.title: Chasing The Rains (追逐雨)
programme.desc: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenixs search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land. (特里尔·阿纳斯塔西亚(Trail Anastasia)是她的牧群,她为了保护两个宝贵的大象幼崽而分裂,而库莱塔则夺回她剩下的猎豹幼崽的领地。 随着天空的开阔和雨水开始愈合茂密的土地,凤凰队与野狗联合寻找新伴侣。)

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives
programme.desc: Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives
programme.desc: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives
programme.desc: Battle harsh environments and relentless challenges and see how the leopard constantly outthinks its enemies to secure food and protect its young. Cross icy peaks and arid riverbeds, where any encounter can change this cats fate for better or worse.

programme.title: Volcanic Odysseys (火山性奥德赛)
programme.desc: The Danakil Depression in Ethiopia is not only one of the most inhospitable places on Earth, but is one of the most geologically active. Now, volcanologist Tom Pfeiffer is taking a group of adventure tourists to cross the Danakil to see the Erte Ale volcano. (埃塞俄比亚的达纳基尔大萧条不仅是地球上最荒凉的地方之一,也是地质活动最活跃的地方之一。 现在,火山学家汤姆·菲佛正带一群冒险旅游者穿越达纳基尔前往埃尔特阿勒火山。)

programme.title: Animals At Play ((动物玩耍))
programme.desc: Young hyenas compete in tug of war, mischievous parrots play at picking apart tourists cars, and Atlantic spotted dolphins enjoy sophisticated social games amid seaweedall following specific rules that hone social bonds. (年轻的土狼在战争中竞争, 恶作剧的鹦鹉玩弄驱散游客的汽车, 大西洋斑点海豚在海藻中享受复杂的社会游戏, 遵守特殊规则,)

programme.title: Extreme Africa ((极致非洲))
programme.desc: South Africas Drakensberg is one of the continents most impressive landscapes. It is home to sharp climatic and ecological gradients as physical conditions change for both land-based creatures and the Raptors that swirl in the skies above.

programme.title: Extreme Africa ((极致非洲))
programme.desc: In north Tanzania, towering mountains line a dramatic valley. Enriched by ancient volcanoes, its slopes provide a variety of habitats for life to thrive and its great centerpiece holds water through even the driest of times.

programme.title: Extreme Africa ((极致非洲))
programme.desc: Simien Mountains National Park in Ethiopia is home to some of the rarest creatures on earth. Take a glimpse into life on some of the highest peaks in Africa, in the last stronghold of shaggy, grass-grazing Geladas, elusive Simien wolves and horned Walia ibex.

programme.title: Extreme Africa ((极致非洲))
programme.desc: The Southern Drylands is a journey into the most arid and extreme environments in the furthest reaches of southern Africa. We go to spectacular but treacherous places where almost no rain falls, to find incredibly resilient creatures and learn the secrets to their survival. From the largest mammals to the fastest insects and even a ghost-like fish found nowhere else in the world, the Southern Drylands contain some extraordinary inhabitants, all connected by the daily challenges of living in some of most inhospitable habitats in the world.

programme.title: Extreme Africa ((极致非洲))
programme.desc: Etosha was once a great lake that dried up and now only fills with water seasonally during the summer rains. Once the Etosha pan is full of water, a myriad of water birds congregate in the shallow lake to breed, most notably Greater and lesser flamingos.

programme.title: Extreme Africa ((极致非洲))
programme.desc: Follow the course of South Africas Orange river from its origins to where it spills out into the Atlantic Ocean. Along the way we encounter a diverse range of habitats and the creatures they support, from the dry lands of the Richtersveld to the beauty of Augrabies this is the story of the Linear Oasis. We reveal how life is adapted to survive along its course and discover a rich world of plants and animals.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks (珊瑚礁碎片)
programme.desc: From opportunistic pirate ships, to well-armed navy vessels, Mexicos Yucatan Peninsula is steeped in maritime history.

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: In this small patch of woodland, two young monkeys face the toughest time of their lives. As they find their place in the world, they must learn which neighbors are allies, and which are foes. Who to trust, and who to avoid. They will suffer loss, and gain friends, as they discover what it means to be part of the Woodland Troop. (在这片小片林地里,两只年轻的猴子面对着他们一生中最艰难的时刻。当他们在世界上找到自己的位置的时候,他们必须学会谁是盟友,谁是敌人。应当信赖谁,应当避开谁。他们将遭受损失,应当获得朋友,因为他们知道加入伍德兰部队意味着什么。)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: The wilds of Zambia are a tough place to live. Here, many animals must come together in groups to help defend territory, protect offspring, find food and overcome predators. (赞比亚的野生动物是生活难以生存的地方. 在这里,许多动物必须团结起来,帮助保护领土,保护后代,寻找食物和战胜掠食者.)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Everyday in the Luangwa Valley a carcass is sighted. Each body holds the story that lead them to their death. In Safari CSI we investigate what killed three carcasses that have been uncovered... (在卢安加瓦谷每天都会看到一个尸体,每个尸体都包含了导致他们死亡的故事. 在萨法里,我们调查了被发现的三具尸体的死因.)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Zambia is home to three very special and different African Edens. The low, hot Luangwa River Valley, the high, dry Liuwa Plain and the cool, wet Kasanka National Park. Defined by the earth on which they sit and shaped by the seasons, each place offers something unique to the wildlife that chooses to live there. (赞比亚拥有三个非常特殊和不同的非洲沙漠。 低、热、热的Luangwa河谷、高、干枯的Liuwa平原和凉爽、湿润的Kasanka国家公园。 每一个地方都为选择在那里生活的野生动物提供了独特的地方。)

programme.title: Wildlife Icons ((野性标志))
programme.desc: Surviving the African savanna requires guile and teamwork for species who live in packs. Follow a day in the life of African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses to see how they rely on their tight-knit families to overcome the challenging landscape. (非洲稀树草原的存活需要生活在群落中的物种的guele和团队合作。 跟随非洲野狗和矮龙鹅的一天生活,看看他们如何依靠紧身的家族克服挑战性的景观。)

programme.title: Wildlife Icons ((野性标志))
programme.desc: A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, everything has a place in natures great scheme. Complex interactions between species are not even limited to animals, and some of the best examples occur in the lush mountain forests of Africa. (复杂的关系网决定了地球上的所有生命:所有物种都是相互联系的,任何物种都不能孤立地生存。 虽然有些关系是片面的,但有些关系是互利的。从松散的结合到紧密的合伙关系,一切都在自然界中占有一席之地。 物种之间的复杂互动甚至不局限于动物,一些最佳的例子发生在非洲茂盛的山林中。)

programme.title: Wildlife Icons ((野性标志))
programme.desc: The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africas amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed for thousands of years, evolving in different ways to a life aquatic. (尼罗河鳄和河马是非洲的两个两栖淡水图标,它们存在于整个非洲大陆的水道、河流和湖泊中,包括南非夸祖鲁纳塔尔惊人的荒野。 这两个物种在几千年中共存,以不同方式演变为水生生物。)

programme.title: Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants ((Tusker: 龙争虎斗 of Elephants))
programme.desc: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal. (让你与所有阶段的非洲大象,克雷格,帕斯卡尔和以扫一起深入了解鱼的复杂生活.)

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale ((The Great 大象 Tale))
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

programme.title: Woodpeckers: The Hole Story (子:洞穴故事)
programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills and get a look inside their secret nests. (向一个独特的禽族家庭稳步前进的鼓棒前进。 了解世界239个木匠物种,从大到小,为什么大自然是最优秀的动物 探索它们的飞行、攀登和呼唤技巧, 并查看它们的秘密巢穴。)

programme.title: A Bees Diary ((蜜蜂日记))
programme.desc: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bees Diary tells that story. (蜂巢里,有成千上万的小动物致力于实现一个共同的目标:殖民地生存.)

programme.title: 三十处男

programme.title: 窥情

programme.desc: 名震赌坛的千王与其拍档受命调查一位上海赌界大亨，怀疑其以赌场为掩护从事间谍活动两人深入危机四伏的赌局世界，在层层布局与试探中步步为营，与强敌展开一场关乎生死与荣耀的斗智对决

programme.title: 除暴安良
programme.desc: 三名持枪劫匪抢劫了一批正在运送的新发行货币，刑警常勇奉命展开调查随着线索逐渐浮现，常勇成功击毙一名劫匪然而，其他两名劫匪不甘就此罢手，乘乱密谋抢劫金厂的黄金常勇凭藉精密的部署，成功粉碎了他们的计划，将不法分子绳之以法

programme.title: 龙的传人
programme.desc: 青年周小龙离开纯朴的离岛到香港发展他的师叔欺骗小龙参加桌球比赛，并以他父亲的地皮作为赌注小龙最后输掉了比赛，幸得他青梅竹马的朋友毛毛鼓励，把自家的田地也作为赌注小龙最后能否把自己的土地赢回来？

programme.title: 宝贝计划
programme.desc: 城中著名的盗贼三人组受聘以3000万元绑架一名婴孩当他们发现黑帮不仅企图吞掉赎金，更要置婴孩于死地后，决定担起保护婴孩的责任，并护送他平安回家一方面要躲避警方追捕，另一方面又遭黑帮穷追不舍，三人即使危机四伏，仍誓死守护婴孩

programme.title: 一眉道人
programme.desc: 一眉道长与徒弟隐居于偏远村庄某日，玛利亚修女计画重建一座荒废已久的教堂，却意外唤醒沉睡多年的僵尸黑袍传教士全镇顿时陷入恐慌，面对传统茅山术失效的绝境，一眉道长唯有与西方驱魔神父联手，融合中西驱魔之法，展开一场惊心动魄的驱魔大战

programme.title: 南北妈打
programme.desc: 关德兴年青时与李消云相恋，遭母亲反对，只好和周申玉结婚关的儿子关仁坚工作上认识了文文申玉发现儿子追求的女友文文，竟是消云的女儿两个妈打情敌又一次碰头，再斗个你死我活

programme.title: 铁线功夫拳
programme.desc: 武术宗师梁坤为保护心爱的女人毅然退隐江湖，不料他的隐忍却换来了爱人的惨死意识到宿命避无可避，他重返武林，在丐帮帮主苏灿的鼎力相助下，梁坤杀出一条血路，誓要向那些冷血仇敌讨回血债

programme.title: 逃学威龙三之龙过鸡年
programme.desc: 富商王百万被发现离奇死于酒店房间，由于周星星与他极为相似，星星再次接受任务，作卧底调查这宗谋杀案王百万生前与妻子感情早已破裂，妻子因此成为头号嫌疑人然而，在调查过程中，星星发现王百万的友人林大岳同样形迹可疑

programme.title: 风流冤鬼
programme.desc: 红歌女阿花遭大户陶老爷奸杀，陶宅即常闹鬼，后陶老爷亦神秘死亡陶之后人陶明嗜赌如命，更因鬼魂作怪而欠下钜款明妻暗中将陶宅售予杨教授夫妇，即遇上怪事连篇...

programme.title: 少年陈真之乱世英雄
programme.desc: 电影讲述清末上海的小人物陈真，在经历苦难及面对无数挑战后，蜕变成长为民族英雄的故事

programme.title: 画皮
programme.desc: 书生王怀卿卖画，为要筹药费救患重病的妻子，途中意外遇上雀妖的追击，幸得狐妖小容相救为躲避雀妖，王怀卿将小容带回家中，三人随即陷入一场情感困局，而一段凄美的人妖虐恋亦随即展开

programme.title: 关云长
programme.desc: 这是一场发生在三国动荡时期的史诗式之旅曹操试图招揽关羽加入他的阵营，但关羽忠于他的结拜兄弟刘备，也是曹操的敌人当关羽试图从曹操手上救出刘备的小妾时，迫于无奈要大开杀戒最后他能否杀出重围？

programme.title: 少年叶问之危机时刻
programme.desc: 1917年，少年叶问初到香港求学英文演讲比赛当天，学校发生一宗惊天绑架案，全校同学都被挟持面对眼前的危机，叶问挺身而出，发现绑匪竟然是自己的师父和好兄弟少年叶问在危机时刻可否打败绑匪，从而伸张正义？

programme.title: 新宿事件

programme.title: 打雀英雄传

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白 第17集
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生谭俊彦饰沈敬一陈山聪饰谢家富何远东饰等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾黄智雯饰萌生情愫，内心更为困惑与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进林嘉华饰亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: 天涯侠医 第5集
programme.desc: 王甫芬医生张家辉为完成女友彤梁咏琪的遗愿而加入国际救援组织生命动力，其后更成立以平民为对象的龙城医疗中心芬随组织在肯尼亚工作时，认识了年轻的齐百恒林峰医生原本在私家医院凌霄医院任职的恒其后亦受芬影响而加入龙城芬以病人为先的精神不但感染了恒，亦叫在凌霄当护士的康乔郭羡妮心仪，可惜芬始终忘不了彤另方面，恒在非洲认识了义工夏晓晴唐宁，对她留下了深刻的印象；其后二人再在龙城相遇，惟晴却因恒身边的富家女高小柔陈敏之而却步恒跟随芬在龙城及生命动力工作，明白到医生除了医病亦能帮助病人活出生命的意义可能医者真的不能自医，助人无数的恒和芬在面对自己的人生挑战时，也有无助的时候......

programme.title: 香港人在北京 第13集
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁陈展鹏饰藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦吴若希饰误堕投资骗局，损失惨重港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲蔡洁饰，婚姻面临考验美食网红徐港文洪永城饰街头歌手徐宝怡戴祖仪饰各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园佛系主义的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传 第15集
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人 第14集
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变......

programme.title: 单恋双城 第2集
programme.desc: 任职旅行社的罗式适陈茵媺为公司开拓新业务，特赴马来西亚与客户开会，谁料被当地滑头导游陆恭梓陈展鹏破坏一切计划，二人因而结怨，式适的男朋友程展博杨明突然现身向她求婚...

programme.title: 状王之王 第11集
programme.desc: 满清年间，聪敏机灵的宋世杰王浩信饰因父亲宋安张达明饰是名狱吏，从小就游走于牢房内，见尽世间不平之事，令他不相信法律有公义世杰长大后亦不愿进官场，纵有真才实学，也只暗中相助同试考生何守信林子聪饰中举，他则偕兄弟宋阿九金刚饰浪游天下世杰及后却被卷进蜘蛛精杀人案中，他为寻真凶展示状师才华，期间更结识了武功高强的青楼护卫玲珑姚子羚饰......案件了结，世杰和玲珑结为夫妻，他亦正式踏上状师之路，还接连遇到一宗宗错综复杂的大案......

programme.title: 法外风云 第9集
programme.desc: 城中两大名嘴律师余英伟黎耀祥和李名扬陈豪在法庭上各施奇谋，针锋相对，英伟反败为胜却差点丧命，令他重新审视人生，他的转变令资深律师卢琛保岳华另眼相看，招揽英伟加盟处理一宗富豪遗产案

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.desc: A.I.는 거장 스탠리 큐브릭 감독이 평생의 숙원으로 삼았던 영화였다. 본래 진짜 로봇을 주인공으로 삼으려던 큐브릭의 목표는 실현되기 어려웠고, 큐브릭은 시나리오와 콘티를 거의 완성해 둔 채로 세상을 떠나고 말았다. 큐브릭의 뜻을 이어받은 것은 스티븐 스필버그 감독이었고, 그는 큐브릭에 대한 경의로 그가 완성해 놓은 부분만큼은 그의 본래 구상과 거의 똑같은 모습으로 만든 뒤 미완으로 남았던 부분에 살을 붙였다. 브라이언 올디스의 단편 소설 Supertoys last all summer lomg에서 착안한 이야기라고 한다. 두 거장의 스타일이 어우러지고 또 충돌하기도 하는 데서 두 사람의 연출 스타일을 비교해 보는 재미가 있고, 식스 센스에서 놀라운 연기로 아카데미 남우조연상 후보에 오르기도 했던 할리 조엘 오스먼트의 연기는 이 영화에서도 뛰어나다. 다양한 미래 세계와 편리한 미래 생활들이 등장하긴 하지만 차가운 배경에서 로봇들과 함께 사는 인간들의 건조한 미래 모습이 드러나기도 한다.

programme.desc: 유아들이 일상생활 속에서 갖게 되는 흥미로운 궁금증과 호기심을 중심으로 다양하게 탐구해나가는 사고력 증진 프로그램입니다. 유아들의 눈높이에서 제기된 참신한 호기심 아이템을 선정하고, 선정된 아이템은 유아 스스로 추론하고 탐구할 수 있는 직접 체험과 다양한 활동 및 시청각 매체를 총동원하여 전개해나갑니다. 이러한 다양한 경험과 활동을 통해 유아들은 새로운 자극을 받게 되고 또 다른 도전감과 새로운 호기심으로 발전해나가면서, 창의적인 아이로 자라날 수 있을 것입니다. 사랑스러운 모야멍, 재미있는 웅이형, 친절한 동이언니, 그리고 우리의 친구 뚝딱딱 삼총사와 함께 호기심의 나라로 날아가볼까요?

programme.desc: 화염에 휩싸인 그날, 진실과 마주하다. 훙예그룹 회장 가오광이의 살날이 얼마 남지 않았음을 안 가오 씨 집안사람들은 유산과 회사를 차지하기 위해 혈안이 된다. 자신의 유일한 혈육인 혼외 자식에게 유산을 물려주고 싶었던 가오광이는 장위안싱을 시켜 아들을 찾게 하고, 장위안싱은 청청을 찾아낸다. 장위안싱이 청청을 데려오기 위해 설득하는 사이 둘의 사랑은 깊어지고, 가오 씨 집안사람들은 새로운 상속자의 등장에 불편한 기색을 드러낸다. 어둠이 드리운 회랑정 호텔의 밤, 갑작스러운 화재가 발생해 장위안싱은 크게 다치고 청청은 생명의 위협을 받게 되는데...

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.desc: 큐브 시계의 등장! 그리고, 새로운 카봇들이 나타났다. 평범한 초등학교 1학년이자 장난꾸러기 소년 차탄에게 남극에 계신 할아버지가 선물을 보낸다. 그것은 다름 아닌 비밀친구, 로봇 자동차 카봇! 이번엔 새로운 선물, 큐브 시계로 카봇을 부를 수 있다! 새롭게 등장하는 개성 만점의 카봇 친구들. 거기에 남극에서 온 친구 펭토킹과 S라인, G라인, T라인 같은 말썽꾼들까지! 시간과 공간이 합쳐져 업그레이드된 큐브 시계를 통해 매력적이고 다양한 카봇들이 총출동한다. 더욱 새로운 카봇들과 친구들이 펼치는 이야기, 헬로카봇 시즌2!
